captions.detailed: A classic laboratory monocular microscope featuring a light grey horseshoe-shaped base, a curved arm supporting a rectangular head, and an inclined black monocular tube. It includes a multi-layered, square black mechanical stage with silver slide clips and a central glass slide. The objective nosepiece is designed to rotate about its vertical axis, while the mechanical stage is structured to slide prismatically both fore-and-aft and left-to-right relative to its carrier support.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a benchtop monocular laboratory microscope with a light grey horseshoe base, a curved arm, and an inclined black viewing tube. The model must feature an adjustable black mechanical stage assembly that can slide prismatically in horizontal directions, and a rotating revolving turret holding multiple objective lenses.
captions.factory: Construct the microscope by assembling separate parts. First, build the static frame including a horseshoe base, a curved arm, and a top block, using boolean operations on boxes and extruded curved profiles. Attach an inclined cylinder for the monocular eyepiece. Create a rotating nosepiece assembly using a thin cylinder and small objective cylinders, defining a revolute joint. Build the stage carrier support, then define a prismatic joint for the fore-aft slide, and another prismatic joint for the left-right cross-slide, using stacked box primitives with slide clips and a central glass slide visual.
